# Purpose

`scripts/analyze_detailing.R` summarises a **synthetic** dataset of luxury-car detailing services. For each service type it reports the number of jobs, the average price (CAD), the average duration (hours) and the average customer rating, and it plots the average price per service.

# Setup

The script uses the `tidyverse` collection (`readr`, `dplyr` and `ggplot2` are the parts it needs).

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Inputs

The script reads one file, `data/detailing_services.csv`, with 120 rows and these columns:

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `service_id` | Unique job identifier (S001 to S120) |
| `service_date` | Date of the service (2026) |
| `vehicle_class` | Sedan, SUV, Coupe or Convertible |
| `service_type` | Type of detailing service |
| `duration_hours` | Time spent on the job, in hours |
| `price_cad` | Price charged, in Canadian dollars |
| `customer_rating` | Customer rating (out of 5.0) |

## Load the data

```{r load-data}
detailing <- read_csv("data/detailing_services.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
glimpse(detailing)
```

# Processing

The data is grouped by `service_type` and summarised with `mean()`. The result is sorted from the most to the least expensive service.

```{r summary}
summary_by_service <- detailing |>
  group_by(service_type) |>
  summarise(
    n_services         = n(),
    avg_price_cad      = round(mean(price_cad), 2),
    avg_duration_hours = round(mean(duration_hours), 2),
    avg_rating         = round(mean(customer_rating), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_price_cad))

knitr::kable(summary_by_service,
             caption = "Summary by service type (synthetic data)")
```

# Outputs

## Summary table

The table above is also printed to the console when the script runs.

## Figure

The script saves the chart below to `figures/avg_price_by_service.png`.

```{r price-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(summary_by_service,
       aes(x = reorder(service_type, avg_price_cad), y = avg_price_cad)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Price by Detailing Service",
    subtitle = "Synthetic data, luxury vehicles",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average price (CAD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# How to run the script

From the project root:

```r
source("scripts/analyze_detailing.R")
```
